# Run-time variables, checks and soft lines against the fake realm's LG answer (tests/e2e.rs).
login
send .wnl hi
send .wnl lg 2589
expect wnl LG matches ^(?P<item>\d+),(?P<median>\d+), within 5s
check %{item} == 2589
check %{median} <= 0
send .wnl lg %{item}
expect wnl LG matches ^2589, within 5s
set two %{item}
check %{two} != 1
check %{two} ~ ^25\d\d$
reject wnl LG within 1s
try expect wnl LG within 500ms
set why_nothing the thing is not live
when nothing send hello
try check field(item,level) == 60
logout
